_doc: Authorized-units allowlist SEED (fleet-ops#1480 / #1548). Generated by the 2026-08-28 machinery audit from the (a) Nish-endorsed and (b) sanctioned-class inventory. Becomes authoritative when Nish human-locks it in the vault. fleet-machinery-authorization-gate evaluate REJECTS new systemd/** / MANIFEST unit lines not on this list (unless the PR carries `authorized-by-nish:`); hunt reports live hand-placed drift and does NOT quarantine until the allowlist is final. Repairs and deletions of existing machinery stay ungated. Add a unit here only via PR after a conference EXCEPTION-APPROVED verdict. Class-(c) unsanctioned builds are deliberately omitted and have follow-up issues filed for adjudication.

adjudicated.rationale: The GH Actions workflow pr-conflict-watchdog.yml in nish3451/siterep already provides this check (same gh call, cap=3, cron '23 * * * *') through the sanctioned repo channel. The VPS timer was a hand-placed redundant duplicate that bypassed the repo; timer was already disabled. Live unit + script deleted. The Actions-minutes cost concern is a Nish money decision, separate from this adjudication.
